cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Record my cake as the fair winner. Please leave lighting comments in the setup section.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You moved yours under the judging light and left mine in the shade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That was a placement adjustment. The results section compares flavor; don't mix the two headings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then include who adjusted it. Put your name in setup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: List the affected tables, please, not personnel. I can approve the results while you complete that section; the first-prize entry is ready.

reason: A uses report headings and level of detail to hide the exact own choice B identifies while retaining judgment of the win.
